svg.metadata: {"id": "s044", "name": "植物温室", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "植物", "光合作用", "劳动"], "desc": "明亮的玻璃温室：拱形白色钢架与玻璃顶，阶梯花架摆满盆栽，吊篮垂下藤蔓，育苗盘、番茄苗与喷雾管。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "outside", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "structure", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sunbeams", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "pipe", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mist", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "planter", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "stand_left", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bench_right", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "hanging", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "foreground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drops", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#BCE5F4", "sky2": "#F1FAF2", "hill": "#CDE8CF", "hill2": "#B4DBB8", "frame": "#FFFFFF", "frame2": "#E1EAE6", "glass": "#E6F6F1", "floor1": "#E3D2B4", "floor2": "#CDB892", "tile": "#D6C3A1", "bench": "#8FC1A3", "bench2": "#6FA487", "pot": "#E58C5C", "pot2": "#CB7444", "soil": "#7A563C", "leaf": "#5BAA6B", "leaf2": "#8ED07C", "leaf3": "#3E8B5A", "f1": "#F28BA0", "f2": "#F7C55E", "f3": "#B49AE6", "f4": "#FF8E5E", "tomato": "#EF5A45", "can": "#5FB7D6", "can2": "#3E97BB", "tray": "#4E5A66", "mist": "#FFFFFF", "pipe": "#B8C4CC", "hang": "#C8A27A"}}
